title: Prisma in Route Handlers
description: Build robust REST APIs using Next.js Route Handlers (app/api/.../route.ts) with Prisma, validation, and status codes.

data.text: When you need to expose public REST endpoints to external mobile apps, third-party webhooks, or client-side fetch calls, Next.js provides **Route Handlers** (`route.ts`). In Route Handlers, you can handle `GET`, `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, and `DELETE` requests directly with Prisma.

data.title: app/api/products/route.ts
data.content: Handling GET with pagination and POST with schema validation.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Use Route Handlers (`route.ts`) for external consumers, mobile APIs, and webhooks.
Always validate incoming request JSON with validation libraries like Zod before passing to Prisma.
Map database and validation errors to appropriate HTTP status codes.
